title: Omnipod Dash Upload to xDrip?
body: So a tech novice here, please be patient. We are moving to the Omnipod Dash insulin PODs in a couple of weeks.  I was hoping for a BT connection between the Omnipod PDM and x-Drip to capture basal rates, temp basal, bolus and carb data...thus avoiding manual entry - more like, eliminating missed entries.  We achieve such good results when we use the predictive capabilities, but too often my teen doesn't make her entries.  Perhaps I am missing something, as I was told about Tidepool and I see they have a partnership with Omnipod, would tidepool upload this information to XDrip?  If the functionality exists for Tidepool and I simply need to rearrange the communication connections, direction to those steps would be greatly appreciated.  If this is a new development...kindly consider. Thanks! - Jim
